messages:
Jordan: getting a 5xx spike on apiserver in asia-east2, controller-manager in a restart loop, and a bunch of GPU nodes showing pods stuck Terminating. starting thread to coordinate.
Maria: saw that, alerted on leader-election errors and etcd WAL growth. looks like a controller-manager churn correlates with heavy etcd write amplification.
Sam: any recent deploys?
Jordan: not for controller-manager. last deploy was 2h ago (non-prod). deploy-bot: Deployment 'model-autoscaler' finished at 2026-03-20T08:05:03Z (ok). not related.
Alex: pulling logs from controller-manager: repeated `failed to update lease` + `object was modified` loops. snippet: ```W0319 07:58:12.345 controller.go:276] error updating lease: etcdserver: request timed out
W0319 07:58:12.346 controller.go:280] failed to update lease for node gpu-pool-22: Operation cannot be fulfilled: the object has been modified; please apply your changes to the latest version and try again.```
Nora: etctd WAL size spiked ~1.2GB in 3m earlier, and compaction backlog didn't keep up. metrics: etcd_disk_writes/sec up x5.
Maria: interestingly, we also see kernel: "IPv6: neighbor table overflow" messages on the control-plane NAT gateways in asia-east2. Could be packet drops causing lease write retries.
Sam: NAT SNAT exhaustion was a previous cause. but nvme/gpu onboarding earlier used lots of ephemeral IPs. run `kubectl get events -A --field-selector involvedObject.kind=Node` shows repeated failures to update status.
Jordan: attaching a quick dump from control-plane host: ```dmesg | tail -n 20
[ 4078.123456] IPv6: neighbor table overflow, can't add entry
[ 4078.123457] IPv6: neighbor table overflow, can't add entry
[ 4079.001234] kernel: conntrack: table full
```
Alex: if conntrack + IPv6 neigh overflow are both tripping, we could be losing apiserver <-> etcd traffic intermittently which would cause leader flips and controller retries.
Nora: GPU autoscaler created ~120 ephemeral mgmt pods this morning for a training wave; most used hostNetwork=false but we had some daemonset sidecars that used hostNetwork for metrics which created candidate connections on NAT boxes.
Maria: action items: (1) throttle autoscaler scale-up in asia-east2, (2) increase neighbor table size on NATs and bump conntrack, (3) force etcd compaction to relieve WAL growth.
Sam: I can flip autoscaler to 30% of current scale for the next 15m. doing now: `kubectl -n infra patch horizontalpodautoscaler gpu-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"maxReplicas":60}}'`
Jordan: Sam, thanks. Maria, do we have playbook steps for bumping neighbor tables?
Maria: yes — run on NAT boxes: `sysctl -w net.ipv6.neigh.default.gc_thresh3=8192` and conntrack: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=2000000`. Will coordinate with infra windows.
Alex: also propose we enable short-term etcd burst compaction: `etcdctl --endpoints=$EPV1 compact --physical-root` (we'll run with backup). Nora agree to snapshot before compaction?
Nora: taking snapshot now: `ETCDCTL_API=3 etcdctl snapshot save /tmp/snap-asia-east2.db` (10% done).
infra-bot: Snapshot job started (job-8372). ETA ~2m.
Jordan: once snapshot is up, Alex please run compaction. We need to keep apiserver available; plan: compaction node-local while leader stable, if leader moves we may pause.
Alex: snapshot complete. running compaction now. `etcdctl compact --endpoints $EP` -> returned ok. also triggered defrag afterwards.
Maria: bumping sysctl on NATs in staging first, then prod. will open change and ping infra-oncall.
Sam: autoscaler patched to maxReplicas=60, scaling events suppressed. monitoring.
Nora: after compaction, WAL growth stabilized and apiserver 5xx dropped back to baseline. leader-election count decreased. GPU nodes still have some Terminating pods due to finalizers; I'll force delete those with grace.
Jordan: thanks team. follow-ups: add a quota for ephemeral mgmt pods per region (to avoid NAT exhaustion), and add IPv6 neighbor metrics to control plane dashboards. filing tickets.
Maria: filed SRE-1482 (ephemeral-pod-regions) and NET-982 (ipv6-neigh-metrics).
Sam: keeping eyes for 30m. so far stable. :thumbsup:
Nora: will run a postmortem doc after stabilization with timelines.
Jordan: closing live thread once 30m stable. great work everyone. :party:
